activity.notes: Representative mid-third-century BCE intellectual-activity point. Xunzi's precise chronology is disputed; SEP establishes his flourishing in the third century BCE, an administrative post in Chu, and survival beyond 238 BCE. This point is not a claimed exact office boundary.
